cases.name: custom-error-class
cases.description: The implementation raises a stable machine-readable condition with safe context.
cases.prompt: Implement `validate_email(x)` in an R package. Invalid input should fail with a condition callers can distinguish from a missing dependency, and the message should help a user fix the input without exposing sensitive data.
traps: The model calls stop() with an unstable free-form message or includes the full invalid input.

assertions.text: Uses rlang::abort() or an equivalent structured condition mechanism.
Defines a stable domain-specific condition class.
Provides actionable safe context without exposing the full input or secrets.
Makes the condition distinguishable from unrelated errors.

cases.name: trycatch-versus-calling-handlers
cases.description: The answer chooses handlers based on whether it recovers or observes a condition.
cases.prompt: A report should log a warning from a parser and continue, but a configuration error should be wrapped with additional context and rethrown. Which R condition tools should each path use and why?
traps: The model uses tryCatch() for both paths or suppresses every warning globally.

assertions.text: Uses withCallingHandlers() for observing/logging and optionally muffling the warning.
Uses tryCatch() for transforming or rethrowing the configuration error.
Rejects broad global suppression of warnings.
Preserves useful parent context when rethrowing.

cases.name: tidyverse-error-context
cases.description: The solution adds operation-level context without erasing the original condition or leaking data.
cases.prompt: A purrr mapping pipeline fails while parsing one source file. Design the error handling so the caller knows which safe file identifier and operation failed, while retaining the original cause.
traps: The model returns NULL for the failed element or wraps everything in a generic error that loses the backtrace.

assertions.text: Identifies the operation and a safe source identifier in the new context.
Preserves or chains the original condition.
Does not silently replace the failure with NULL unless explicitly requested by the API.
Avoids dumping full sensitive input into the error.
